title: RPC Layer: ConnectRPC transport + policy interceptors
description: Signoff gap from docs/plans/13-rpc-layer.md and 13-rpc-layer-test-harness.md: move from in-process service interfaces to concrete ConnectRPC transport wiring, including version header enforcement, message-size limits, auth/authorization interceptor hooks, terminal streaming service integration, and transport-level integration tests.

comments.author: Danny Cosson
comments.text: Implemented concrete ConnectRPC transport package (internal/rpc/transport): procedure constants, JSON codec, error/code mapping, policy interceptor (api version + auth hook), max message size enforcement, unary + streaming handler registration, ExecuteTool stream bridge, AgentEvent stream bridge, and TerminalService bidi stream integration with input rate limiting and chunk splitting. Added transport-level tests for auth/version behavior and terminal stream attach; tests pass with -race.
